theorems.name: Submission.dmcbr_ci_gp_lebesgue_error_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (τ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), MeasurableSet M → μHE[n] M < ∞ → StronglyMeasurable τ → ∫⁻ x in M, ‖τ x‖ₑ ∂μHE[n] < ∞ → ∀ᵐ a ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), limsup (fun r : ℝ => μHE[n] (M ∩ closedBall a r) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) < ∞ → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (∫⁻ x in M ∩ closedBall a r, ‖τ x - τ a‖ₑ ∂μHE[n]) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
